name: 情况处理 (31N)
description_en_html:
Overview

Critical business situations, such as upcoming deadlines and pending confirmations, can negatively impact your business if users aren’t aware of them and don’t take action. Situation Handling speeds up the resolution of urgent issues by detecting them automatically, informing the right users, and proposing follow-up actions. With its monitoring capabilities, you can optimize your business processes by tracking the life cycle of situations from alert to solution.

With the standard framework, you can select from a wide range of predefined use cases and adapt them to your business requirements. By using Intelligent Situation Automation on SAP Business Technology Platform you benefit from automatic resolution of situations.

With the extended framework you can model your own situations from scratch by reusing existing application artefacts.

Key Process Flow

Standard Framework

  • Use the integrated Responsibility Management (1NJ) scope item to determine the users responsible, based on team structures and responsibility rules
  • Adapt predefined use cases based on your business requirements
  • Get informed about situations by notifications on SAP Fiori launchpad, by email, with in-app situation messages in the relevant SAP Fiori apps, or by using the My Situations app
  • Navigate from the notification to the relevant business app, where you can find more information about the situation and act on it
  • Monitor the life cycle and handling of situations
  • Collect situation data to prepare the automated resolution of situations, where applicable

Extended Framework

  • Use the integrated Responsibility Management (1NJ) scope item to determine the users responsible, based on team structures and responsibility rules

  • Model custom use cases

  • Get informed about situations by notifications on SAP Fiori launchpad, by email, or by using the My Situations – Extended app

  • Monitor the life cycle and handling of situations

  • Navigate from the notification to the My Situations – Extended app where you can find more information about the situation and act on it

Business Benefits

  • Bring urgent situations to the attention of the right users

  • Provide users with contextual information and proposed actions in one place

  • Benefit from predefined use cases across lines of business

  • Create custom use cases with the extended framework

  • Get insight into the life cycle of situations and optimize business processes

  • Collect situation data for advanced analytics

  • Lay the foundation for automating the resolution of business situations with Intelligent Situation Automation on SAP Business Technology Platform
description_zh_html:
概览

如果用户不知道并且不采取行动，关键业务情况（例如即将到来的截止日期和待定确认）可能会对您的业务产生负面影响。情况处理通过自动检测紧急问题、通知正确的用户并提出后续操作来加速解决紧急问题。借助其监控功能，您可以通过跟踪从警报到解决方案的情况生命周期来优化业务流程。

使用标准框架，您可以从各种预定义用例中进行选择，并根据业务需求对其进行调整。通过使用基于 SAP Business Technology Platform 的智能情况自动化，您可以从自动解决情况中获益。

使用扩展框架，您可以通过重用现有应用程序部件从头开始建模自己的情况。

关键流程流

标准框架

  • 使用集成的职责管理 (1NJ) 范围项目根据团队结构和职责规则确定负责用户
  • 根据您的业务需求调整预定义用例
  • 通过 SAP Fiori 快速启动板上的通知、电子邮件、相关 SAP Fiori 应用中的应用内情况消息或使用“我的情况”应用了解情况
  • 从通知导航到相关业务应用，您可以在其中找到有关情况的更多信息并采取行动
  • 监控生命周期和情况处理
  • 收集情况数据，准备自动解决情况（如果适用）

扩展框架

  • 使用集成的职责管理 (1NJ) 范围项目根据团队结构和职责规则确定负责用户

  • 建模自定义用例

  • 通过 SAP Fiori 快速启动板上的通知、电子邮件或使用“我的情况 - 扩展”应用了解情况

  • 监控生命周期和情况处理

  • 从通知导航到我的情况 - 扩展应用，您可以在其中找到有关情况的更多信息并采取行动

业务优势

  • 让正确的用户注意紧急情况。

  • 在一个位置为用户提供上下文信息和建议的操作。

  • 从跨业务范围的预定义用例中受益

  • 使用扩展框架创建自定义用例

  • 深入了解情况的生命周期，并优化业务流程

  • 收集情况数据以进行高级分析

  • 使用基于 SAP Business Technology Platform 的智能情况自动化为自动解决业务情况奠定基础
